close_reason: opinion: 6 bools are intentional RFC 5280 policy switches; API break with no safety gain
description: lib.rs:512 — ValidationPolicy has 6 bool fields (enforce_key_usage, initial_explicit_policy, initial_any_policy_inhibit, initial_policy_mapping_inhibit, require_subject_alt_name, require_rfc822_san). Clippy pedantic struct_excessive_bools fires (>3). The bools are intentional policy flags matching RFC 5280 §6.1.1 and the struct is #[non_exhaustive] public API, so refactoring to enums is a breaking change. [opinion] Unless the API is being revised, suppress with #[allow(clippy::struct_excessive_bools)] and a comment.
title: [rusty/pkix-path] struct_excessive_bools on ValidationPolicy
